Sana ay nasa mabuting kalagayan ka at ang iyong pamilya sa kabila ng patuloy na pag-ulan dulot ng Bagyong Opong. Para manatiling ligtas, ito ang ilang paalala:

1) Store enough food and drinking water.
2) Have an emergency bag with a flashlight, batteries, candles, and a first-aid kit.
3) Be sure to charge your phones and power banks.
4) Prepare extra clothes and toiletry kit should there be a need to evacuate.
5) Always be updated on the latest news and LGU announcements.

Salamat at ingat lagi!

Never click on links from unknown senders. These links can steal your personal data, bank info, and money. Be aware and cautious always.
Legitimate companies will never ask for your passwords, OTPs, or credit card details via text. Protect your info-never share it with anyone. Don't click links from whatever source.
Did you win a prize or receive a package you didn't expect? If an offer seems too good to be true, it's a scam. Trust your gut and ignore it. Don't click links from anyone.
Received a suspicious message? Delete it immediately. To verify a message, contact the company directly using official channels- do not click the link from the text.
